notes.title: The Nest is now completely free, forever.
notes.content:
It is with a mix of pride and sadness that I announce we are making The Nest free for all, forever. 

We had high hopes for this game, and in 2016 after an unexpectedly successful launch, we tried to remake the small demo game into something more massive, and more epic than we were ultimately able to pull off.

The Multiplayer which we came to love...could not keep concurrent players, so most people never got to play the game that we saw in testing. With unflinching determination, Victor kept improving the Multiplayer, added an entire Co-Op Campaign, and even started remaking single-player levels. 


With the game going free, our hope is that enough people will try it out that they can experience the game the way it was intended. You will find bugs, and if you try the Co-Op campaign you'll find a number of mechanics like healing players with a blow-torch, riding in vehicles that might make you sick, and the vestiges of a number of incomplete features. 

The Multiplayer PvP mode is what should provide the most fun. Gather 4-6 players, try out the two different classes, and just go nuts. 


The final announcement is that Victor has moved on to a truly epic new job, but that means the chances of updates and patches are near zero. He will still be on Discord, and we'll all jump in to play from time to time, but there's nobody left to continue the game, so The Nest has reached its final form.

Cheers.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.8
notes.content:
Balance:
- Sniper headshots are now instant kill.

Features:
- Snap turning for oculus users! A 360 setup is no longer required.
- Added master volume control, voice volume is still WIP.
- Added prototype health bar HUD, can be disabled/enabled in general settings.
- Added a "class select prompt" when the player first joins a match.

Improvements:
- Reloading the pistols are now easier and it feels better.
- Sniper "predator" effect is now cancelled upon taking damage.
- A launched teleport grenade is now destroyed and cancelled if locomotion input is initiated again.
- Pistol projectile tracers are now shorter.
- Increased size of Angroid sniper scope.

Fixes:
- Game will now default to oculus keybinds if playing with oculus, no manual choice needed.
- Fixed menu trace rotation on oculus touch controllers.
- Fixed projectile tracers going through objects after collision.
- Mothership ambiance is now looping.
- "Player joined" VO is now properly working.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.5, Oculus Rift support!
notes.content:
Oculus with touch controllers are now fully supported! A 360 tracking setup is required, but snap turn might become an option for the sniper class if there is interest.

Design:
- CTRL Points now has the shape of a cylinder, and should be less visually intrusive, while still providing good information on current control status.

Features:
- A ghost shader has been added to dead player avatars
- Teleport grenades are BOOM no more! Enjoy new SFX not recorded with my voice.

Fixes:
- CTRL Points no longer spawn at the same location twice.
- Teleport grenade will no longer fire if an occupied nest was targeted. Same if locomotion is currently on cooldown.
- Refactored reload on slinger pistols, it no longer matters if they're colliding with objects. Should be easier to reload in general.
- Outpost23(level): Added out of bounds volumes on top of start zones to prevent spawn camping. More polish.
- Relic(level): Added a killvolume if player falls through the map. Fixed some rocks that a player could climb inside of (thanks ZyferTV).

notes.title: Patch 0.2.3
notes.content:
The holidays are over, my fever is gone and I survived food poisoning. Which means I can get back to work.

Features:

- Outpost23(level) is now crowned! Check out the new centerpiece.
- Experimental HardlightVR support. This has been in the project forever, but I finally got my suit back and so I was able to update the plugin. It needs some iteration to become a good haptic experience but the ground work has been done.

Fixes:

- The game window no longer needs to be in focus for audio, microphone and controller input to work!
- Slinger will no longer dip into the floor if killed while climbing.
- Projectiles no longer spawns "GroundHit" particles if they already damaged a player.
- Fixed "return to ship" logic in Relic(level). You can now properly exit the game.
- Updated match info board in motherships to display new character icons.

notes.title: Singleplayer/Multiplayer
notes.content:
The project has gone through much since it was last updated, and the old code base (which wasn't much of a base) had to make room for the new.

The multiplayer patch isn't the end of single player content, I've just moved the old branch to a beta that you can opt into.

Right click the game in your library, then go to Properties - > Betas, click the drop down and select "legacy_content".

I'm working on single player content for the new networked codebase, I'll hopefully have some stuff to share in the next week or two.

Thanks for reading, the new year is almost here and I wish you all a creative one.

notes.title: The Nest: "Ctrl Alt Delete" Multiplayer Update is Live!
notes.content:
This has been an exhausting journey, but The Nest has been reborn as a competitive multiplayer game! 

The patch is live for all owners, and we hope a bunch of you join us online. The game is Early Access, so this is more like a beta than a finished game, and every bit of feedback helps.

We especially want feedback on balance of the different classes at different skill levels.


Cheers,

Invrse

notes.title: Holiday Achievements Are Live!
notes.content:
We had a lot of fun taking a break for trying to ship Multiplayer, and instead making some fun Holiday art for people to check out during the Steam Sale. In retrospect, we probably should have mentioned these earlier...

[list]
[*]You can now shoot down Santa. 

[*]There is a hidden achievement. It does not relate to the robots, so use your imagination.

[/list]

The Holiday art and achievements will stay live for a few more weeks, mostly because we find it very charming. 

The next update to the game will be the Multiplayer patch, which may introduce bugs, as the game has been totally rebuilt inside a new version of Unreal. We could publish it today, but there is an engine bug in 4.14.1 that breaks the game when interleaved reprojection is enabled.

notes.title: The Nest Early Access 0.3.0 Leaderboards and Holiday Update
notes.content:
It has been a while since our last update, which has no doubt made our Early adopters worry that the game has been abandoned. Far from it! 

Nearly all of our efforts have been put into the [b]Multiplayer PvP[/b] mode that will be testing soon, so watch out for a beta announcement. In the meantime, our new developer has navigated Steamworks to bring some much needed Leaderboards, and even our first unlockable Achievement!


[*] [h1]Leaderboards are now live![/h1] Compete against the Steam community for high scores

Practice Mode and Time Trial mode have different scoring and separate leaderboards

Scores are impacted by accuracy, headshots, difficulty, and damage taken 

Speed only effects score in Time Trial mode 

[*] Our first [b]Achievement[/b] has been added. [u]Trick VR Treat![/u]
Earned by completing Hard Mode with pumpkin heads. (Available till Nov 9). Will unlock a pumpkin hat in the near future

[*] Swapping hands is now enabled. Press "T" on the keyboard 
[b]OR[/b] open the Menu, go to Settings, and swap hands there

[*] Fixed particle collisions on ground caused by different physics materials

notes.title: Patch Notes: The Nest – Early Access Update 0.2.3 HOTFIX
notes.content:
[*]A bug has been fixed where Ryan wrote the wrong version number on the latest patch notes. Those responsible have been sacked.

[*]Align Nest now resets position to default when choosing "Turn" option. This should prevent issues where a nest which has been dragged a long way and then turned can place the menu out of reach.

[*]A failsafe has been added if a player still finds they are in the wrong position to access menu. Hold down the "start" button for 8 seconds to reset all customizations to the nest position and rotation. (rifle customizations will not be reset)

[*]Adjust Scope Position can no longer remain active in Time Trial mode after exiting the menu.

[*]Opening main menu while end-of-game text is displayed will no longer result in overlapping menus.

[*]Fixed an issue where one robot would occasionally not count towards final score, thus making the level never finish.

[*]Added collision volumes to robots arms below the elbow.

[*]Fixed physics asset constraints so that hands no longer float in space after a kill.

[*]Laser Trace in menu now updating visuals at proper rate.

[*]Dead robots can no longer be shot multiple times to increase final score.

[*]Letters from menu can now be shot for fun.

notes.title: Patch Notes: The Nest – Early Access Update 0.1.3 MIXED REALITY UPDATE!
notes.content:
[list]

[*]Mixed-reality customization: Nest Alignment. By entering the "Customization" menu and going to "Align Nest," players will now be able to move the nest location for maximum comfort and immersion. Try matching the window with a real-world object like a couch or chair, or lowering it to the ground and laying prone. Grab the widget with the trigger and drag it to desired location. "Turn" rotates the environment 90° to the right. "Default Height" allows easy snapping to the intended ground plane, while "Default All" resets all alignment changes. 

[*]The Scope has been rewritten! Due to popular demand, and to make our lives easier, the scope has been redesigned. Zoom increments and readout are now more closely tied, and finally make sense. The scope now behaves in a more realistic fashion, while still being user-friendly. This will affect the way the game plays for those who have practiced extensively, but we hope you will like it as much as we do!

[*]Visual indicator for reload cooldown turned back on.

[*]Final score now awarded in Practice Mode.

[*]Taking damage will now count against your score. Accuracy, headshots and difficulty are the most important factors to a good score. (time does not matter in practice mode)

[*]Robots no longer have Blaster arm by default. This weapon will be added in with a special effect in the next patch.

[*]A new "Experimental" section has been added to "Settings" menu. Currently it has a rough version of a 2-handed control scheme. Not recommended yet, but try it if you want a challenge.

[*]Hard Mode robots redesigned. Enemy robots now wear armor that protects the head and chest. Very precise shots to the eye and back of neck can still result in a headshot kill.

[*]The Menu has been reorganized: "Customize" added to main menu, and now contains "Crosshair," "Rifle Tilt," "Scope Placement" and "Align Nest," most of which were formerly in "Settings." "Restart Level" moved inside "Level Select."

[*]Menu font texture updated.

[*]Menu opening and closing sounds added.

[*]Sound effect added to indicate when scope is at min or max zoom level.

[*]Holding down the trigger now fires repeatedly on cooldown. This may solve a trigger-related problem that we believe varies by hardware.

[*]We've added our first Easter Egg. Good morning, what's your bid?

notes.title: Patch Notes: The Nest – Early Access 0.1.2
notes.content:
Important: Graphics Settings have changed! If you notice any performance problems, go to Settings > Graphics and find the sweet spot. 

Our first patch is live, and contains a few small fixes along with several features requested by the community. It is now much easier to align real-world controller attachments with the in-game rifle, using our new Customize Alignment mode.

Press Start button, go to Settings > Customize Alignment

-	Choose “Rifle Tilt” or “Scope Placement”

-	For “Rifle Tilt,” click up or down on the Thumb-Pad to find a more comfortable tilt angle.

-	For “Scope Placement,” click up or down on the Thumb-Pad to move it higher or lower. Click left to move the scope away from the stock. Click right to move it closer to the stock.

The Sniper Rifle has gotten a make-over. The geometry has been cleaned up significantly and the UVs and textures have finally been redone.  Original 15 materials and 45 textures condensed to 2 materials and 6 textures. Additional Skins will be added soon.

Refactored rifle to allow for further customization and additional weapons in the future.

Reconfigured Graphics Settings to allow higher resolution scaling. 

-	Low 130%
-	Medium 150%
-	High 180%
-	Very High 200%

Fixed an issue where Robots who shot each other played rifle hit sounds.

Fixed an issue where Robots could get stuck in the roof of buildings, or jump down off buildings.

Try holding side grips and pulling trigger to fire Stasis Sphere. This AOE attack slows enemy actions by 90%, but also causes aggro. 8 Second duration. 15 Second cooldown. Note: This may change in future builds.
